title: Umrah Tadabburiyah
lead: Umrah while learning to reflect on the Qur'an where it was revealed — Madinah and Makkah — with i'tikaf in the Prophet's Mosque and the Grand Mosque.
seo: Umrah Tadabburiyah: Umrah together with learning tadabbur of the Qur'an in Makkah and Madinah, with Markaz Tadarus Indonesia.

aims.title: Goals
items: Learning the greatness of the Qur'an.
Learning the keys to reflecting on the Qur'an.
I'tikaf in the Grand Mosque and the Prophet's Mosque.

strengths.title: What makes it special
items: Learning the Qur'an from its meaning through to living it.
Intensive tadabbur guidance before and after the programme.
Coming home loving the Qur'an more.

before.title: Before departure
items: The Umrah of the Prophet and his companions.
The virtues of Makkah and Madinah.
The keys to tadabbur of the Qur'an.

after.title: Back home
items: Regular Tadarus guidance, online and in person.
